objectives: Describe Jacob's burial and the mourning of the Egyptians.
Explain Joseph's forgiveness of his brethren.
Explain Joseph's oath concerning his bones.
takeaways: The Egyptians mourned for Israel seventy days, and Jacob was buried in the cave of Machpelah.
The Canaanites took the mourning company for Egyptians: Abelmizraim.
Am I in the place of God? Ye thought evil against me; but God meant it unto good.
Always keep the spirit of forgiveness; the Most High means it unto good.
God will surely visit you, and ye shall carry up my bones from hence; Moses took the bones of Joseph.
